scope: Dev9 development analyses only; all outputs remain analysis_only and have no publication, clinical, deployment, Qualification12, or Held-out27 authority.
principles: Published anchors are method and presentation comparators, never numerical gold standards.
Full-cohort prevalence and absolute outcome summaries may remain descriptive when a first-24-hour exposure makes same-window adjusted outcome inference temporally unsafe.
Only case protocols contain task-specific definitions; shared prompts and method owners remain case-neutral.
No unavailable external cohort, control arm, censoring process, or replication result may be synthesized.

decisions.decision: Use all eligible ICU stays for descriptive Sepsis-3 prevalence and absolute in-hospital mortality. Use a 24-hour landmark among stays alive at 24 hours for the adjusted association of the first-24-hour Sepsis-3 classification with subsequent in-hospital death. Adjust for age, sex, and charlson_first as baseline prognostic factors. Preserve the full-cohort association, non-readmission restriction, and flexible age/Charlson forms as explicitly labelled sensitivities.
decisions.claim_boundary: Observational prognostic association only; not the causal effect of sepsis and not a patient-level prevalence estimate when patient identity is unavailable.
decisions.implementation_route: Reuse the generic association-model-grid authority; update only the E1 case protocol/runtime projection and affected deterministic reporting suffix.

decisions.decision: Keep full-cohort KDIGO stage distribution, absolute mortality, and ICU length-of-stay summaries descriptive. Use a 24-hour landmark for the adjusted post-landmark mortality association, with KDIGO stage categorical and stage 0 as reference; adjust for age, sex, and charlson_first. Add two prespecified sensitivities: an ordinal-linear stage model and a creatinine-only KDIGO definition, while keeping the full composite creatinine/urine-output/RRT definition primary.
decisions.claim_boundary: Prognostic gradient only; LOS remains median/IQR plus ordered trend and is not interpreted causally. Concurrent non-renal SOFA components are not called baseline confounders.
decisions.implementation_route: Extend the generic association-model-grid/definition-axis contract, then replay only E3 deterministic analysis and reporting owners.

decisions.decision: Keep measured-versus-unmeasured bilirubin accounting in the full cohort and never encode unmeasured bilirubin as normal. Use a 24-hour landmark among stays alive at 24 hours and with observed first-24-hour bilirubin for the adjusted post-landmark mortality association. Model bili_max with a restricted cubic spline as primary, adjust for age, sex, and charlson_first, and add linear-per-unit and bili_first-versus-bili_max sensitivities.
decisions.claim_boundary: Association among measured stays only; the result does not identify the full-cohort bilirubin effect and does not make missing-at-random assumptions.
decisions.implementation_route: Reuse the generic landmark-spline owner and a generic exposure-definition sensitivity; update only the M1 case protocol/runtime projection.

decisions.decision: Retain the current patient-group 80/20 held-out internal validation as the primary development evaluation. Add ten prespecified repeated patient-group 80/20 splits with sealed seeds derived from master seed 1729 and summarize AUROC, Brier score, calibration intercept, and calibration slope across splits. Preserve the complete-case refit as the missingness axis.
decisions.claim_boundary: Internal validation only. The source material contains no independent hospital, database, site, or calendar-time coordinate, so external or temporal transport validation remains unavailable and must not be claimed.
decisions.implementation_route: Add one generic repeated-group-split prediction-validation adapter; do not create an M2-only model implementation.

decisions.decision: Treat absent external replication as an explicit evidence boundary, not an executable Dev9 defect. Run only the provider-free deterministic publication-figure/reporting suffix after the registered clustering result remains unchanged.
decisions.claim_boundary: Internal candidate phenotypes, analysis_only; no stable biological subtype or external reproducibility claim.
decisions.implementation_route: Use the already repaired generic publication-figure suffix; no new clustering method or Provider call.

decisions.decision: Retain the 24-hour landmark and the current Cox model as a PH diagnostic, not an authorized headline estimate when the global PH test fails. Add an extended Cox model with a constant ventilation coefficient and prespecified age, sex, charlson_first, and sofa2_max interactions with log1p(time from landmark in days). Add the unadjusted 27-day post-landmark RMST difference as an absolute, PH-free sensitivity. Do not add IPCW because 94,452 of 94,458 source stays have fixed-horizon endpoint support and the observed non-event censoring is administrative at day 28.
decisions.claim_boundary: Descriptive prognostic association only; ventilation timing is first observed in ICU and neither the adjusted HR nor RMST difference is causal.
decisions.implementation_route: Add a generic extended-Cox time-interaction adapter and reuse the existing generic RMST kernel; update only the H1 case protocol/runtime projection.

decisions.decision: Freeze the existing verified-non-use-unavailable fail-closed result.
decisions.claim_boundary: No comparator, propensity score, or causal effect estimate is authorized.

decisions.decision: Freeze the existing no-interior-BIC-optimum fail-closed result.
decisions.claim_boundary: No selected K, named trajectory subtype, or outcome association is authorized.

execution_after_approval: Implement only generic typed owners and case-local protocol projections named above.
Run focused owner tests, then provider-free affected-case deterministic replays; do not rerun Planner or Coder when the saved plan remains valid.
Rebuild the 9-task run-bound shadow review without using anchor numerical results as expected answers.
When Dev9 has no unassigned actionable gap, build one exact-HEAD image and run one exact-HEAD full CI.
Keep Qualification12 and Held-out27 at zero until the exact-HEAD freeze is verified.
